poc_plan_summary: POC objective: validate Dedicated performance and routing controls for chat + semantic search. Canary plan: start with 5% prod traffic routed to a 2-node reserved GPU pool (dedicated) in us-east. Model variants: baseline (open-medium-16b) and quantized variant (open-medium-16b-q4) for cost tests. Fallback plan: automatic routing to hosted_api in us-west on node failure or sustained latency >2x baseline; region failover path us-east -> us-west -> eu-west. Rollback criteria: >5% regression in relevance (eval prompts), 95th pct latency >2s, or error rate >1%. Monitoring KPIs: token latency p50/p95, cost per 1k tokens, semantic similarity NDCG on eval set. SE to instrument tracing hooks and set alerts before canary start.
